events.name: Rocket Bake Sale
events.intro: A cheerful stall sells cookies "for sick Pokémon". The cashier's collar says R, and the cash box has no charity sticker.

success.text: They hand over a cookie and a fake smile. The cookie is delicious.
The authorities swoop in. A grateful official tips you off.
"Prepare for trouble!" The cash box is worth fighting for.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Aqua Leak Patrol
events.intro: A cracked pipe sprays sea water across the path. Two Team Aqua grunts argue over whose fault it is.

success.text: You wrestle the valve shut. The grunts, soaked, wave you off.

failure.text: The pipe bursts in your face. Cold, but not hurt.

success.text: "You will not stop the flood!"
Your Water-type drinks the spray happily. The pipe drains, the grunts flee.

events.name: Magma Quarry Strike
events.intro: Team Magma is strip-mining the hillside. Rare ore glints in the cut, behind two guards and a drill rig.

success.text: "This is OUR mountain now!"
You slip along the spoil heap and pocket ore before they notice.

failure.text: A guard spots you!

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Galactic Toll Booth
events.intro: A makeshift booth bars the road. A Galactic grunt taps a sign: "Road tax for a new universe. ₽400."

success.text: The barrier lifts. "Thank you for supporting the future."
You talk about how important you are. He waves you through, confused.

failure.text: "No pass, no payment? Battle!"

success.text: He sighs, then sends out a Pokémon.

events.name: Plasma Rally Interrupt
events.intro: A Plasma speaker is mid-speech on the plaza steps: "Pokémon deserve freedom!" The crowd turns to look at you and your team.

success.text: You say that bonds are a choice, and the crowd cheers. Plasma slinks away.

failure.text: You stumble over your words and the crowd boos.

success.text: Plasma are delighted. A grunt slips you a pamphlet and a coin.
Security in white and teal moves in.

events.name: Flare Salon Spy
events.intro: The stylist is humming a little too casually as she asks about your route and your team. A red lipstick is shaped like a Team Flare logo.

success.text: "Oh, you caught me!" She grins and snaps her fingers.
She trades her information for a better offer. "I never saw you."

failure.text: She smiles, takes your tip, and leaves without a word.

success.text: She writes it all down. Somewhere, a Flare scout wastes a day.

events.name: Yell Cheer Chorus
events.intro: A knot of Team Yell fans fills the road. "We won't move unless you sing along!"

success.text: You nail the beat. The fans cheer and wash your team with fresh energy.

failure.text: You miss a few notes. They let you through, politely.

success.text: The fans turn into a wall of noise and Pokémon.

events.name: Rocket Radio Hijack
events.intro: Every radio nearby buzzes with the same jammed signal. A Team Rocket transmitter hums on a pole.

success.text: A jolt resets the receiver. The broadcast clears and a grateful operator tips you.
You cross the right two wires. The signal returns.

failure.text: Sparks fly. The radio is toast.

success.text: Rocket grunts rush out.

events.name: Stolen Cargo Truck
events.intro: A truck marked with a big R barrels past. Crates tumble out of the back and roll down the road.

success.text: You vault the tailgate and haul back the cargo.

failure.text: It outruns you. You grab a few crates by the roadside.

success.text: A handful of crates is all that is left. Loot!
The driver pulls over, furious.

events.name: Aqua Submarine Dock
events.intro: A hatch in the sea wall opens onto a hidden dock. A Team Aqua submarine sits at the pier with one guard on watch.

success.text: You tiptoe across the hull when the guard turns away. Inside, a locker full of loot.

failure.text: A klaxon blares!

success.text: "Intruder!"
You get the evidence. The authorities pay for it.

events.name: Magma Seismograph Tamper
events.intro: The village seismograph blares a quake alarm, but the ground is perfectly still. A Team Magma grunt leans on the cable box.

success.text: The alarm stops. The villagers thank you with supplies.

failure.text: You only make it louder. The grunt snickers and runs.

success.text: "Everybody evacuate! Hahaha!"

events.name: Cyrus's Orders
events.intro: A folded note lies on a bench, signed with a stern C. It lays out the next Galactic operation, step by step.

success.text: You tip off the right people. The operation collapses, and your rival hears about it.
You take their route. It saves you a day.
You leave it where it lay. A grunt is relieved, and tips you.

events.name: Blank Soldier Duel
events.intro: A silent Plasma soldier steps from the trees. "N asks only one thing. Do your Pokémon fight for you, or with you?"

success.text: You kneel to your Pokémon and speak. The soldier nods, and lets you pass with a gift.

failure.text: Your answer comes out stiff. He turns away.

success.text: "Then show me."

events.name: Flare Fashion Heist
events.intro: Two Flare members dash off with your best accessory! A third waits at the corner, twirling a scarf.

success.text: "Fashion is a battlefield!"
You tackle the thief at the next corner and snatch it back.

failure.text: They are gone. You buy a replacement trinket.

events.name: Skull Dance Break
events.intro: A boombox thumps and Team Skull grunts form a circle. "Dance-off, yo! Win, and we bounce!"

success.text: You nail every beat. The crew dissolves, laughing.

failure.text: You trip over your own feet. They keep the beat and the cash.

success.text: "Not into dancing? Fine, battle!"

events.name: Rocket Disguise Gig
events.intro: A spare grunt uniform hangs on a hook by the hideout gate. The guards do not look closely at faces.

success.text: You nod, grunt, and stroll inside. The loot room is open.
You snip the alarm wire as you pass. Nobody notices.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Double Agent
events.intro: A villain you have fought before waits at the roadside, hat low. "I'm done with them. Let me tag along for a while."

success.text: A short-term ally joins you for the next stretch.

choices.label: Take a tip and say goodbye

success.text: They give you useful information.
"A trap?! You'll regret it!"

events.name: Villain Ransom Note
events.intro: A note pinned to a tree: "We have your item. ₽700, or come and get it." One of your bag's pockets is open.

success.text: You hand over cash. The item comes back with a smirk.
The kidnappers are not happy to see you.
It was probably not that valuable.

events.name: Meteorite Fakeout
events.intro: Treasure hunters swarm a "meteor" glowing in the hillside. It is flat painted rock. The crooks wait for someone to dig.

success.text: "The fakeout worked!" The crooks pounce.
They thank you with a share of what they did find.

failure.text: They do not listen.

success.text: You follow them to their stash and lift a few things.

events.name: Hideout Vent Crawl
events.intro: Three vents lead off in three directions. You can hear voices, humming machinery, and the clink of coins.

success.text: You drop into a guard room.
A generator room. You pocket spare parts.
A cash room. You take what you can carry.

failure.text: An alarm! You scramble back out the vent.

events.name: Laser Maze
events.intro: Red beams cross the corridor ahead. A vault door glows at the far end.

success.text: Your Psychic-type guides the team through the beams. The vault opens.
You wriggle between beams, right to the vault.

failure.text: An alarm trips! Grunts rush the corridor.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Security Camera Swap
events.intro: A wall of monitors flickers in the guard room. A tape deck sits under the desk, labeled "LOOP".

success.text: Guards watch an empty corridor. You walk right past.

failure.text: The loop cuts out! Guards arrive.

success.text: Alarms ring.

events.name: Password Lock
events.intro: A keypad glows on a steel door. Three notes are taped nearby: "Where we began." "First letter, last letter." "Count the badges."

success.text: Click. The door swings open on a stash.

failure.text: Wrong! The alarm brings guards.

success.text: A lucky guess! The stash is yours.

failure.text: Wrong! The alarm brings guards.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Boss Phone Call
events.intro: A public phone rings by itself. A rasping voice: "I've been watching you. Choose your words carefully."

success.text: "We'll see." The line goes dead. They will remember this.
They laugh and promise not to go easy anyway.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Friendly Seller
events.intro: A friendly seller beams as you approach. Their prices are a little too good. Their boots are standard-issue.

success.text: The goods are fine. A grunt winks as you leave.
"Oh no. The jig is up!"

events.name: Gadget Sabotage
events.intro: A small villain drone buzzes behind you, blinking a camera light. It has been following for a while.

success.text: Your Pokémon smashes it. A circuit board falls out.
You lose it in the trees.

failure.text: It follows you and snaps a photo.

events.name: Hostage Negotiation
events.intro: A grunt holds a trainer's Pokémon behind a crate. "One step closer and it's over!" Everyone is looking at you.

success.text: You trade a favour for the Pokémon. Everyone walks away.

failure.text: The deal collapses!

success.text: You pretend the police are circling. He bolts and drops everything.

failure.text: He calls your bluff!

success.text: "Then I'll fight you!"

events.name: Raid on a Safehouse
events.intro: A shuttered house hums with villains. Room by room, a whole squad waits.

choices.label: Take the squad one by one

success.text: The first guard is waiting by the door.
The authorities handle the raid. A reward trickles in.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Villain Grunt School
events.intro: A class of nervous rookies in oversized uniforms cluster around a whiteboard. The teacher looks up: "Can you show them how it's done?"

success.text: You run a demo. The rookies are in awe and owe you a favour.

choices.label: Sit in the back and listen

success.text: You learn a thing or two about villain tactics.
"Class dismissed! Battle!"

events.name: The Rookies Return
events.intro: The rookies from the grunt school wave from the roadside, a gift basket in hand. "We remembered your lesson!"

success.text: A basket of supplies from grateful rookies.
They turn their backs while you pass the checkpoint ahead.

events.name: Stolen Egg Lab
events.intro: A lab full of incubators, some empty. One Egg sits in a villain's case, tagged "STOLEN".

success.text: The lab guard stands in front of the case.
You scoop the Egg and run. It's warm in your arms.

failure.text: The case alarm blares!

events.name: Experiment Gone Wrong
events.intro: A wild Pokémon stumbles from a villain lab, glowing and twitching. A broken tank leaks behind it.

success.text: It lunges, confused and scared.
You calm it down with a soft voice. The glow fades, and it follows you.

failure.text: It panics and attacks!

success.text: You hope someone finds it.

events.name: Prison Break
events.intro: Cages line the cellar wall. Each holds a scared Pokémon. A single key hangs on a hook by the guard.

success.text: The guard won't give up the key!
You pick a lock and one Pokémon slips out and follows you.

failure.text: The lock rattles. Nothing happens.

events.name: Mind Control Helmet
events.intro: A Pokémon in a flashing helmet blocks the corridor, eyes glazed. A grunt works a console.

success.text: The controlled Pokémon attacks!
The helmet pops off and the Pokémon shakes its head. It joins you.

failure.text: The console zaps back!

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Black Market Poké Ball Sting
events.intro: A man in a trench coat sells "special" Poké Balls out of a van. The ring is bigger than he lets on.

success.text: "Run!"
The balls are fine. Do not ask.

events.name: Cargo Ship Ransack
events.intro: A freighter rocks at anchor. On its deck, a crew of villains dive for crates as waves crash over the rail.

success.text: The deck heaves under your feet.
You come back after the crew leaves, and take a few loose crates.

events.name: Doom Clock Bomb
events.intro: A red clock ticks down over a stack of crates. Two wires, one red and one blue, run from a dented box.

success.text: Snip! The clock stops. A relieved grunt thanks you from behind a barrel.

failure.text: BOOM! A smoky bang rocks the room.

success.text: The clock stops!

failure.text: BOOM! A smoky bang rocks the room.

success.text: You back away, quickly.

events.name: Fake Gym Front
events.intro: The gym looks ordinary, but the sign is crooked and the trainers inside look nervous. A hidden stairwell door sits behind the trophy case.

success.text: Behind the trophies, a stair leads down to a hideout stash.

failure.text: The trainers close ranks!

success.text: The fake leader smirks.

events.name: Spy Dead Drop
events.intro: A sealed envelope is wedged behind a loose brick. It is addressed to no one in particular.

success.text: They are grateful, and pay you for it.
A shadow takes it from your hand and pays well.

choices.label: Read it and put it back

success.text: You learn where their next base is.

events.name: Villain Bounty Board
events.intro: A notice board lists bounties. One wanted poster carries a villain name and a reward.

success.text: You sign the slip. The target will turn up later.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: The Bounty Target
events.intro: The target from the bounty board steps from the shadows, ready to run.

success.text: "You will never take me alive!"
You tear the slip. They slip into the dark.

events.name: Lockpick Lesson
events.intro: A retired burglar offers to teach you the craft over a cup of tea. "Never know when you will need it."

success.text: Click, click. You have the knack.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: A Locked Chest
events.intro: An old chest with a stubborn lock sits in a ditch. You smile and take out your picks.

success.text: Click! The chest is full of treasure.

events.name: Pyromaniac Sweep
events.intro: A villain with a torch cackles as fire spreads across the field. Villagers shout for help.

success.text: Your Water-type floods the field. The villagers cheer.
You stamp out the flames with a blanket.

failure.text: The fire flares up, singeing your team.

success.text: "Burn, baby, burn!"

events.name: Magma Flood Valve
events.intro: A great valve controls the lab's coolant. Flood the lab and everything dies. Drain it and the lab burns.

success.text: Steam fills the air. The Fire-types are subdued, and so are yours.
Heat roars up from the vents. Fire burns brighter.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Aqua Tide Turner
events.intro: A big dial on a tower controls the tide. Aqua wants it high, and Magma wants it low.

success.text: The sea rises and your Water-types feel strong.
The sea falls back and the land sings. Your Ground-types feel strong.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Galactic Gravity Well
events.intro: A device on a pole bends the light around it. Pebbles drift towards the next node ahead.

success.text: Galactic guards rush out.
You jot down its design. It could be useful.

failure.text: It tugs at your pockets. A few coins drift away.

events.name: Plasma Banner Burn
events.intro: A huge Plasma banner hangs over the plaza, with a rival's ad pinned to its corner. A match would do wonders.

success.text: The banner goes up. Your rival is impressed.
You fold it away. The authorities pay you for it.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Team Neo Rookies
events.intro: Three bumbling villains in very new uniforms trip over their own banner. "We are... Team Neo! Prepare for... something!"

success.text: They send out one tiny Pokémon each.
They are so grateful they give you their lunch money.

events.name: Grunt Union Strike
events.intro: Grunts picket the road with signs: "FAIR PAY FOR VILLAINY". They refuse to fight anyone. A clipboard waits for a signature.

success.text: They wave you through and slip you a union perk.
"Scab!"

events.name: Shady Surveyor
events.intro: Four people mill around a market stall. One of them lifted a wallet just now. You saw something, but not clearly.

success.text: You point at the right one. He drops the wallet and runs.

failure.text: You accuse a bystander. Awkward.

success.text: Lucky! You nab the thief.

failure.text: Wrong person. Awkward.

success.text: You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Villain Letter Mix-up
events.intro: The postman hands you a letter addressed to a Team grunt. It orders a mission, a sealed bag, and a bonus.

success.text: The bag holds a stolen item, and a note: "Bring it to the dock." You keep the bonus.

choices.label: Return it to the post office

success.text: The postman is relieved, and gives you a reward.

events.name: Shadow Pokémon Exchange
events.intro: A dealer offers to lend you a Shadow Pokémon for a few battles. "It hits hard. Just keep it away from the light."

success.text: The Shadow Pokémon joins your party.
You leave it be and walk on.

events.name: Stakeout
events.intro: A shady meeting is about to happen in the building across the street. You can wait and watch, or step in right now.

success.text: You see the whole handoff. You can step in now, or let it pass.
You burst in on the handoff!

events.name: Contraband Detector
events.intro: A gate scans your bag. A bored guard says: "Anything shady in there? Better be nothing."

success.text: The gate beeps happily. Clean!
The guard waves you through.

failure.text: The alarm blares. You pay a small fine.
